title: Comparing hashes after a text change
description: You can follow two strings into hash digest comparisons.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: calculate_hash creates a hasher. You encode text as bytes, update the hasher and return its hexadecimal digest.
The first call hashes Hello, World with its supplied punctuation. You store and print the returned digest string.

steps.question: Will the supplied strings produce equal digest values?
steps.answer: No. The second string adds an exclamation mark, and the supplied output shows two different digests.

steps.description: You see False from the equality check. This comparison detects the change between these two supplied inputs.
